hero.caption: Aerial view of a small section of the Houston Ship Channel on Buffalo Bayou, which leads upstream directly into the city of Houston, Texas, USA. The downtown section of Houston can be seen at upper right. The city of Galena Park, Texas is at center right in this photograph. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers dredges and maintains the channel for deepwater shipping. View is to the west.

images.filename: Bolivar Lighthouse -- Point Bolivar, Galveston, Texas.jpg
images.caption:
Point Bolivar Light is a historic lighthouse in Port Bolivar, Texas, that was built in 1872. It served for 61 years before being retired in 1933. The current lighthouse is at least the second structure at the site. The first lighthouse was built in the mid-1850s and was taken down during the Civil War so Union warships could not use it as a navigational aid. After withstanding over 150 years of erosion, the lighthouse is now entirely black. This has caused some to call it "The Haunted Lighthouse" of Bolivar.
Bolivar Peninsula is named for the South American hero Simon Bolivar.
